_comment: Speaker-identification spec for the 2026-07-22 regular meeting (transcript bc229650-86f4-4bfd-892a-dc8b438b6ff2). speakers[] feeds the API (max 10, description guides matching); overrides/splits encode the manually verified corrections the API could not make on its own.

speakers.name: Vital Anne
speakers.description: Board President; chairs the meeting, announces agenda items, asks for resolutions, calls and announces the votes; addressed as Mrs. Anne

speakers.name: Matt Haupt
speakers.description: Trustee; reads the suggested resolutions aloud when the president asks; the STT sometimes wrote his name as Mr. Hauff

speakers.name: Audra Melton
speakers.description: Trustee, addressed as Dr. Melton; moves and supports motions

speakers.name: Ayesha Potts
speakers.description: Trustee, addressed as Ms. Potts; moves and supports motions

speakers.name: Stephanie Zendler
speakers.description: Trustee attending virtually, addressed by first name Stephanie; participates in discussion but cannot vote today; drops off and rejoins

speakers.name: Richard Machesky
speakers.description: Superintendent (Dr. Machesky); speaks on the lacrosse cooperative, district strategy and budget direction

speakers.name: Dan Trudel
speakers.description: Assistant Superintendent for Business Services; presents the budget reduction scenario and finance items while sharing a screen; says a printout is on BoardDocs

speakers.name: Brian Canfield
speakers.description: Director of Employee Services; reads the personnel considerations 6A-6D including the finance director appointment of Kyle Anderson; the president thanks him as Mr. Canfield

speakers.name: Rob Carson
speakers.description: Director of Maintenance and Operations; reports on summer construction and facilities work such as the Athens gym and Boulan Park Middle School

speakers.name: Public commenter
speakers.description: Member of the public during non-agenda public communication; says they speak as a parent and that being a vendor is a small side thing

notes: Attribution: AssemblyAI speaker_identification + manual verification against the packet rosters.
Diarization split the chair's voice into clusters A+B (merged as Vital Anne).
A few utterances by Dr. Audra Melton co-clustered with Ayesha Potts (e.g. the 8.C reading ~29:24).
Cluster I held two people; split by time: Stephanie Zendler (remote, early) / public commenter (67m+).
'Mr. Hauff' in the STT text = trustee Matt Haupt (Gary Hauff now sits on the Oakland Schools ISD board).
In-person board: Anne, Haupt, Melton, Potts; virtual non-voting: Zendler; absent: Alic, Philippart.
